decisions.decision: The Salad Bar will be reinstated on the last Thursday of each month at the meal site.
decisions.quote: the salad bar will be reinstated on the last thursd ay of each month at the meal site

decisions.decision: The cribbage day was changed from Mondays to Tuesdays because attendance is increasing and space is limited.
decisions.quote: the cribbage day has been changed from mondays to tuesdays.

decisions.decision: The Lunenburg Turkey Hill Lions Club pancake breakfast stays on the 2nd Wednesday of the month, per participant preference in the questionnaire.
decisions.quote: participants preferred to keep this event on the 2

decisions.decision: Pamphlet printing was dropped as too expensive; pamphlets will remain at the senior center and other Town locations.
decisions.quote: researched printing costs but has come to the conclusion that it would be too expensive of an undertaking.

decisions.decision: The Board of Selectmen procedure from 1998 will be followed to pick the next Boston Post Cane recipient, with the Town Clerk and Director making the determination.
decisions.quote: the town clerk and director will be making the determination of who the recipient will be.

decisions.decision: The board set the Annual Volunteer Appreciation Cookout for August 17, 2015, 11AM-2PM.
decisions.quote: the board set the date of august 17, 2015, from 11am-2pm, for the annual volunteer appreciation cookout.

decisions.decision: The Director will contact the Fire & Police to request their help with the Volunteer Appreciation Cookout.
decisions.quote: the director will contact the fire & police to request their help again this year.
